assembly_and_sign.saved_element_definition: E[e,2*a+c] = rounded compensated sum_q w[q] P[e,q,c,J] grad[q,a,J], with volume-area Jacobian and thickness included; E is saved material_residual, not a new contraction of saved rounded P.
assembly_and_sign.global_definition: G = np.bincount(edofs.ravel(order=C), weights=E.ravel(order=C), minlength=27378), exactly the original split_displacement.py:200 material path. split_kernel_invariants_hu.py:366 instead scatters total residual.
assembly_and_sign.on_body_local_definition: a[e,a,c] = -E[e,2*a+c] for local node connectivity[e,a] belonging to the 703 fixed body nodes; no other local node is selected.
assembly_and_sign.on_body_saved_global_definition: w[n,c] = -G[2*n+c], n in body nodes. This is body load, not the holding reaction on the model; the latter has opposite whole-vector sign.
assembly_and_sign.whole_definition: Saved weak whole component is math.fsum(-G[2*n+c] for all canonical body nodes n). Local support whole/group/node quantities use only selected a, without rerunning force evaluation.

proposed_accounting_closure_rules.original_order_replay: Recompute only the saved-array scatter np.bincount(edofs.ravel(),weights=E.ravel(),minlength=27378), same C-order as original, and require value-exact equality to saved global_material_force. This is a source/assembly replay identity, not a new continuum-force or pressure gate. A mismatch is investigated as a saved-data/order/runtime accounting mismatch, not automatically a solver defect. Do not promise bitwise cross-implementation arithmetic independently of runtime; field SHA bindings still verify original input bits.
proposed_accounting_closure_rules.complete_support_partition: All selected (cell,local node,component) terms appear exactly once in one of the five support classes. Replay covers full global vector; diagnostic projection selects only 1406 body DOFs. Outside-body local force terms do not enter body load.
proposed_accounting_closure_rules.node_and_whole_projection: Use math.fsum over original selected signed local scalar terms. Compare per-node and whole/group recompositions to minus saved rounded global selection. Do not require exact equality after reordering.
proposed_accounting_closure_rules.roundoff_scale_definition: For component c and any tested node/subset, A_c = math.fsum(abs(float(E[e,2*a+c])) for the exact selected local elemental terms). A_c is elemental-contribution L1 before within-node cancellation, not L1 of rounded nodal resultants.
proposed_accounting_closure_rules.suggested_new_projection_envelope: B_c = 8 * 2**-52 * A_c, with no absolute floor. This is a proposed saved-element projection accounting envelope, explicitly distinct from unchanged old nodal closure.
proposed_accounting_closure_rules.mathematical_basis: Let eps=2^-52, u=eps/2 and gamma4=4u/(1-4u). A body DOF receives at most four original float64 element terms, so naive sequential accumulation differs from its exact sum by at most gamma4 times local elemental L1. Allow up to one eps times the input L1 for each correctly/nearly correctly rounded math.fsum reduction. Up to three new fsum aggregation layers plus the saved-global whole fsum remain below (gamma4+4eps+O(eps^2))*A_c, less than 8eps*A_c. This statement assumes finite float64 values/sums, no overflow, and the verified max-four topology. Pure addition of representable subnormal operands whose exact sum is subnormal is exact; this proposal introduces no force-scale floor. More aggregation depth, duplicated terms or products are not covered and must not silently inherit the envelope.
proposed_accounting_closure_rules.critical_distinction: A cancellation-heavy node can have almost zero saved nodal load while carrying large opposite element terms. Therefore the old 8eps*sum(abs(original node force)) is not a valid generic bound for element-to-node rearrangement. Retain it exclusively for the original M1/M2 nodal table recompositions; do not replace or relax that original gate.
proposed_accounting_closure_rules.zero_case: If selected elemental L1 is zero, all selected terms are zero and exact zero projection closure is expected.

physical_comparison_and_limits.existing_values: The two saved material-only line vs weak differences copied in accepted_state_bindings motivate local support diagnosis, especially peak state 13 Fy difference -0.09424957122266045 N. No new numerical cause is claimed from this preparation.
physical_comparison_and_limits.same_owner_comparison: Compare saved PTRACE bottom/left/right line vectors with matching cell-support group resultants. Keep body and the two corner-only support contributions explicit. Then distinguish diagonal support omitted by line traces from volume-basis vs boundary-trace differences within the same edge-owner cells.
physical_comparison_and_limits.discrete_basis: An owner group sums -integral_K P grad(s) dV, where s is the sum of Q1 shape functions whose nodes lie on the body. The independent PTRACE line is integral_body_face P N_body t dS. Integration by parts contains additional outer-cell faces and material Div(P) terms, and P is sampled/contracted with different volume and boundary quadrature. Material alone need not satisfy Div(P)=0 because Hu contributes to the original equilibrium.
physical_comparison_and_limits.corner_basis: A diagonal cell touches the body only at one node yet its Q1 shape gradient has support through that cell area. Its saved local weak load may therefore be nonzero without a finite-length physical body edge. Such a contribution is a finite-element weak-support term; it is not a measured point contact pressure.
physical_comparison_and_limits.fixed_overlay: The body interior is fixed, with F=I and zero Hu expected; internal zero P cannot represent exterior load. Keep its actual saved element-force contribution in the ledger rather than omitting it by assumption.
